title: Menu
lead: Create reusable navigation trees and assign them to locations supported by the active template.

sections.title: Create a menu
body: Create a menu with a clear name and add page links, anchors or validated URLs. Set parent relationships to build submenus and arrange their order.
Draft or missing pages are omitted from public navigation. The public template chooses the actual Navbar, Sidebar, List or Dropdown presentation.

sections.title: Choose a location
body: The editor reads locations, permitted types and maximum depth from the active template manifest. Dynamic items and assignments stay in the menu repository.
Changing templates preserves unsupported assignments and shows a warning. The component picker can insert a public projection of an assigned menu.

sections.title: Recover changes
body: Use Trash for recoverable removal and History for catalog revisions. Saves verify revisions and template state to prevent silent overwrites.

sections.title: Full public navigation data
body: menu:tree(key: active-template location key) supplies name, type and items with label, href, slug, anchor, newTab and children. Up to five item levels are declared; submenu items use the same fields. Unpublished/private page targets are omitted. menu:location remains a compatible flat-card service.

Bind menu:tree with alias navigation. Write {{#navigation.items}}
  • {{label}}{{#children}}{{label}}{{/children}}
    • {{/navigation.items}} inside your own nav/ul markup. Layout and behavior belong to your template and authored HTML. Missing location assignments return an empty items list.
